column3: “Made great” is rendered “promoted,” and “placed his seat above” as “established his authority over.”
“Kneeling” is rendered “bowed down,” and “bowing down” as “paid homage.”
“The words of Mordecai” is rendered “Mordecai's reason.”
“Despised in his eyes” is rendered “disdained,” and “annihilate” as “destroy.”
“Someone cast Pur” is rendered as passive. NASB supplies “until.”
“It is not appropriate for the king” is rendered “it is not in the king's interest.”
“Let it be written” is rendered “let it be decreed.” “The doers of the work” is rendered “those who carry on the king's business.”
“According to the good in your eyes” is rendered “as you please.”
“Province and province” and “people and people” are rendered with “each.”
“Documents” is rendered “letters,” and “runners” as “couriers.” “Spoil” is rendered “possessions.”
